rows.medi_said: أنا سمعت / متأخر اليوم. صحيت. That's right.
rows.why: He said sami3t (I heard) for s7eet (I woke up); she said صحيت and he repeated it with "That's right" (GR-24 example).

rows.medi_said: أأأ أنا صحيت تأخر.
rows.why: He used ta2a55ar where the adjective mit2a55er is needed; her later line restates the sentence to move on, not a clear fix (the engine may have dropped the m-).

rows.medi_said: آآآ على عشرة.
rows.why: Her whole reply was "el" and he fixed it to على العشرة (GR-25).

rows.medi_said: Okay أنا شوي-- أنا كان قنيش شوي--
rows.why: kaan was not conjugated for 'I'; she said أنا كنت and he repeated أنا كنت شوي.

rows.medi_said: هادي الصباح. / هاد الصباح.
rows.amal_said: We never say هذا الصبح just say الصبح or بالصباح.
rows.why: He said 'this morning' with a demonstrative (feminine هادي on a masculine noun, then هاد); she said we never say that, just el-subu7 / bel-sabaa7.
rows.proposed_rule: 'This morning' is just el-subu7 or bel-sabaa7, with no hada/hadi in front: ana kunet kasool el-subu7.

rows.medi_said: أنا لا مش / شجاع اليوم. مش شجاع اليوم.
rows.why: She asked lissa mish mitshajje3; he answered shujaa3 (brave), same root, wrong form; she recast متشجع.

rows.medi_said: أنا لازم / آآآ عطلة و
rows.why: laazem went straight to a noun; she gave the verb in English ('you should take') and he said لازم أخد عطلة (GR-27).
rows.english: I need to take a vacation.

rows.medi_said: أنا لازم أخد عطلة وسفر، سفر.
rows.why: He used the noun safar where the verb asaafer is needed; her English rephrase 'I should travel' made him say لازم أسافر (PG-22).

rows.medi_said: أنا خططت / امم / سفر، / سفر
rows.why: 5a66a6 takes la- (plan for); she said 'You plan for' and he said لا سفر (la-safar).

rows.medi_said: بس أنا راح / آآآ على / عموي.
rows.amal_said: Sorry بس أنا راح what?. / راح going. What's going؟
rows.why: ra7 had no verb after it; she asked what 'going' is and he said راح أروح.
rows.english: But I'm going to my uncle's.

rows.medi_said: راح أروح على / and عموي.
rows.amal_said: Either على or عند which one؟ Can't put two.
rows.why: He stacked two prepositions (3ala + 3ind; engine wrote 3ind as 'and'); she said you can't put two.

rows.medi_said: Uh, we haven't used and a lot, but, uh, so rahu / and amuwi.
rows.why: He stuck -i onto 3ammo (3ammo-i); she recast عمي twice and he took it ('That's right').

rows.medi_said: Rah bida.
rows.amal_said: No. It's the reason of our whole one month long lesson.
rows.why: For 'we will have fun' he tried ra7 bida (unclear word); she said No and pointed to the month-long lesson, then he said ننبسط.

rows.medi_said: for camping. ... Tesh-teshki?
rows.why: He forgot the word for camping and asked; after a hint she supplied تخييم.

rows.medi_said: Talat Asha Alfayn Sitwa Ashrin.
rows.why: For the date (13) he said talat 3asha (dinner); she echoed عشاء and asked what it means, he said dinner - her echo shows it was his word, not the engine.

rows.medi_said: المصاري راح / يجي،
rows.chat: el-masari ra7 yiju fi tani youm
rows.why: Plural masari needs plural yiju; she had just said it is plural and typed yiju but did not voice a fix.

rows.medi_said: هذي اليوم التانية.
rows.amal_said: مم، مم، هذي اليوم. / مرة، هذي المرة.
rows.chat: hadi el-marra el-tania illi bashufek elyoam
rows.why: He said el-yoam (day) for el-marra (time); she echoed هذي اليوم and gave مرة، هذي المرة, he took it.

rows.medi_said: So ساعة الأول-- It should be ساعة الأول.
rows.why: Feminine saa3a needs el-oola (and the noun needs el- too); she recast الساعة الأولى.

rows.medi_said: الأول اليوم.
rows.chat: awal el-sa3a = the beginning of the hour
rows.why: He repeated her أول اليوم with el- on awal; she said that means nothing (the first word of an idafa never takes el-).

rows.medi_said: مرة، uh، مرة الأخر. / مرة الأخيرة.
rows.why: Noun + el- adjective needs el- on the noun too; she recast المرة الأخيرة.

rows.medi_said: الرحلة أخيرة.
rows.why: He read back her الرحلة الأخيرة without el- on the adjective; she said الأخيرة.

rows.medi_said: غير يوم." "غير اليوم." I'll see you another day.
rows.chat: bashufek 8eir yoam = i'll see you another day
rows.why: 8eir before a noun never takes el-; he said غير اليوم and she recast غير يوم.
rows.proposed_rule: 8eir before a noun never takes el-: 8eir yoam, never 8eir el-yoam (nafs is the opposite: nafs el-ishi).

rows.medi_said: هي ال، ال، الختيارة ال أول." Is it awwal?
rows.why: Feminine 5ityaara needs el-oola; she said الأولى and he repeated أولى.
rows.english: She is the first old woman in our program.

rows.medi_said: Yes، uh، tan-- uh، تاني، / تاني حدا.
rows.amal_said: تاني حدا would mean the second person.
rows.why: For 'someone else' he put taani before the noun, which means 'second'; she said that means the second person.
rows.proposed_rule: taani before a noun means 'second' (taani 7ada = second person); after the noun with no el- it means 'other / else' (7ada taani).

rows.medi_said: Oh، you're right. Uh، هذا الثاني.
rows.amal_said: حدا التاني is / no. X. Just حدا تاني.
rows.why: Engine wrote هذا الثاني; her echo shows he said 7ada el-taani - indefinite 7ada cannot take an el- adjective; she said no, just حدا تاني.

rows.medi_said: آخر / عشرة / دقايق. عشرة دقايق؟
rows.amal_said: عشر y. / y عشر not عشرة.
rows.why: Before a plural noun, 3-10 drop the -a ending; she said عشر not عشرة.

rows.medi_said: الأخيرة. No، wait. دقيقة is، is masculine. So، أخ-أخير.
rows.why: The adjective must agree with plural da2aaye2; she gave أخيرات and he took it ('Oh, because it's plural').

rows.medi_said: you say it was dwarf? What was it again?
rows.why: She taught ضيف ضيوف minutes earlier as a new word; he asked again and she supplied it.

rows.medi_said: نفس الطريقة
rows.chat: ana basoo2 nafs el-taree2 kul yom
rows.why: He said taree2a (way/method) for taree2 (route); she said طريق and asked what طريقة means, then he said نفس الطريق.
rows.english: I drive the same route every day.

rows.medi_said: القانون لغير مش نفس ال-- / uh، إشي من / نفس.
rows.why: He restarted into ishi min nafs; she prompted مش نفس... and he said مش نفس الإشي (her صح may only answer 'did I say it right').
rows.english: The rule for 8eir isn't the same thing.
rows.proposed_rule: nafs comes first and the noun after it takes el-: mish nafs el-ishi, not ishi min nafs.
